Players Committee card image of [[Turn It Off! Turn It Off! (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect. OR If opponent just deployed a [Maintenance] card, it may not battle for remainder of turn. OR Cancel Out Of Commission (if attempting to place a card out of play). (Immune to Sense.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/turnitoffturnitoff.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ca1ccff62ff30b7e29da803f91a6d09ab542d803 ca1ccff] (3 October 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
